probabilistic_semantics.randomness: public effective sampler, reducible to an explicit random tape; fair-bit source is canonical
probabilistic_semantics.termination: almost sure termination is sufficient for exact external sampling

nondeterministic_semantics.branching: effective finitely branching or computably enumerable branch choices
nondeterministic_semantics.externalization_target: computable enumeration of reachable terminal presentation support

externalization.sampler: an external public algorithm given only N and P that has exactly the runtime output law
externalization.support_enumerator: an external public algorithm enumerating every reachable terminal presentation and no unreachable presentation

theorem_boundary: If all operational resources used by the runtime are present in the public effective specification, a universal interpreter externally reproduces the probabilistic law; effective nondeterministic support is enumerable. A claimed nonexternalizable survivor must therefore import a resource outside this frozen class rather than branch opacity alone.
